title: Degreewise epimorphism of the restricted sections factorization
statement: For any scheme X, bounded-below complex K, presentation T, integers q,n, the degree-n factorization of the restricted sections inclusion through T.L.step q is epic.

proof.text: Evaluate factorThru_arrow at n for the already proved restricted-sections factorization. Its image therefore lies in the subobject represented by the degree-n step inclusion. Precomposition with the explicit finite-diagonal comparison isomorphism does not change the image of the mapped-total inclusion.

For each s in the finite interval [q,n], write s=q+(s-q).toNat. The stupid-truncation inclusion in degree s is an isomorphism. Applying sections, extending the resolution complex by zero, and evaluating at n-s preserves this isomorphism. The total-map coprojection identity identifies the restricted coprojection followed by the mapped-total inclusion with this isomorphism followed by the full coprojection. Hence the image of every full retained coprojection lies in the image of the mapped-total inclusion. Finset.sup_le and T.filtration_formula give the reverse containment. The argument is vacuous when n<q and works for negative q and zero summands.

The two containments give equality of the sections inclusion image with the subobject of the degree-n filtered step. Transport the factor map along Subobject.underlyingIso to that subobject. The proved upstream lemma epi_of_imageSubobject_comp_arrow_eq makes the transported map epic; composing with the underlying isomorphism gives the original degree-n factor map and preserves epimorphicity.

theorem etaleRestrictedSectionsLift_component_epi
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (q n : ℤ) :
    Epi (((T.L.step q).factorThru (etaleRestrictedSectionsInclusion X K T q)
      (etaleRestrictedSections_factors X K T q)).f n)
